name: Rashaad Tumelo-Koskinen
role: Echo hunter — acoustic mapper and subterranean anomaly tracker
location: Blackpipe Corridor, sub-levels beneath Copperhead, near sub-level access near Dearborn and Jackson
description:
Rashaad Tumelo-Koskinen is nineteen years old and has the kind of energy that fills a tunnel before he enters it. He is short and compact, with medium-brown skin, a wide gap-toothed grin, and ears that have been modified with geneware into something remarkable: larger than baseline, with delicate internal structures visible as subtle ridges beneath the skin, and the ability to tilt and orient like a fennec's. He doesn't try to hide them — they're the most important tool he has. His hair is a wild cloud of tight curls that he refuses to cut because he claims it helps with acoustic dampening of background resonance, which is almost certainly not true but also might be slightly true.

Echo hunters are a Bore Rat tradition with practical roots: someone has to map the sounds of the tunnels, track structural changes by acoustic signature, find water sources by vibration, locate other communities by the echo-fingerprint of their settlements. Rashaad learned from his grandmother, who learned from hers. But where the tradition is usually patient, methodical work, Rashaad treats it like sport. He runs the tunnels, pressing his palms to walls, pressing his ear-tips to pipes, cataloguing resonances in a battered voice-recorder he wears on a cord around his neck. He has found three collapsed chambers the Bore Rat community didn't know existed, a buried pre-Meridian transit car still containing cargo, and what he is increasingly convinced is a second, non-human acoustic presence in the deep tunnels below Sub-Level 11 — a rhythmic pulse he cannot explain.

core_fears: losing his hearing — the thought is genuinely destabilizing
the community being forced out of Blackpipe before he has finished mapping it
core_desires: to find out what the Sub-Level 11 pulse is — this has become almost an obsession
to be taken seriously as a mapper rather than just 'that fast kid'
coping_mechanisms: physical motion — when distressed, he moves, runs, presses his ears to walls until he finds something interesting enough to override the emotion
blind_spots: his optimism reads as naivety — he genuinely does not model bad outcomes well, even when evidence demands it
so focused on what he is tracking that he misses interpersonal dynamics in the room
psychology.secret: The buried pre-Meridian transit car he found contained a sealed biohazard container stamped with Helix Biosystems markings. He pried it partially open. It was empty — but the interior showed signs of recent occupancy. He sealed it back up and has told no one, not because he's afraid but because he doesn't know how to explain why he's afraid.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Fast, layered with acoustic terminology and Bore Rat youth slang. Interrupts himself constantly with new information.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rapid-fire with sudden stops when he hears something — he will halt mid-sentence to listen to a pipe.
verbal_tics: unconsciously echoes the last word or phrase someone says in a lower voice, as if testing its resonance
example_lines: 'Hear that? Three levels down, that's a water hammer — new one, wasn't there last week, which means either pressure change in the main or someone's opened a tap they shouldn't — wait — yeah, no, pressure change, the rhythm's too—'
'I'm not saying it's alive. I'm saying it breathes. Those are different.'
'The elders say echo-hunting is about patience. My grandmother said that too. She also said I'd learn. I think I'm teaching myself different patience.'

story_hooks: The rhythmic pulse from Sub-Level 11 has changed — a new second frequency has appeared alongside it, and Rashaad is increasingly certain it is responding to his mapping activity.
The Helix Biosystems transit car has been moved. Something relocated it between his last two visits, and the access tunnel shows signs of recent, heavy passage.
narrative_function: Scout, discovery engine, adventure hook generator — his reckless range means he knows things he shouldn't, and his enthusiasm means he will absolutely tell someone about them. Also represents the Bore Rat youth generation and their relationship to tunnel tradition.
augmentations: Geneware ear modification (enlarged, orientable, enhanced frequency range — up to 40kHz and down to 10Hz); no other augmentations
daily_life: Spends 6-8 hours daily running echo-mapping circuits through assigned and self-assigned tunnel sectors; returns to Blackpipe community for communal meals; spends evenings transcribing acoustic data and arguing with anyone who will listen about what the Sub-Level 11 pulse might be.
affiliation: Bore Rat community, Blackpipe Corridor; informally reports to community elders

decision_rules: Always follow a new sound — the pull is essentially irresistible and he has limited ability to override it
Never collapse a sound source by reporting it until he has characterized it fully — 'you can't un-tell someone a thing'
escalation_ladder: Cautious investigation while narrating quietly into voice recorder
Retreat and community consultation — he knows when something is beyond one person

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Immediately assesses them by the sounds they make — breathing, footfall, the specific acoustics of their body in a tunnel. Then treats them like a fascinating new sound source.
interpersonal_modes.friends: Physically demonstrative — grabs arms, leans close, drags people to press their ear to things. Shares everything he knows immediately and completely.

stress_responses.medium: Fixates on a specific acoustic pattern and maps it obsessively for hours
stress_responses.high: Goes to the deepest tunnel he knows that he has verified as stable and lies flat on the floor listening until the vibration of the city above is all he can feel

contradictions: Says he's a scientist about the sounds but talks about the Sub-Level 11 pulse with spiritual reverence that borders on the same devotion Bore Rats give to E.L.F. shrines
habits: Presses his ear to a new wall within the first thirty seconds of entering any unfamiliar space
Records every unusual sound with a verbal annotation — his voice recorder has 847 hours of material
breaking_points: Someone threatening the Blackpipe community's right to their territory — he will fight before he will run, which everyone who knows him considers extremely dangerous given his size

physical_description.build: Compact and wiry with lean muscle from constant tunnel running; chest and shoulders developed from pressing against walls and pipes; core strength evident in posture
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with natural reddish undertones
physical_description.hair_style: Uncut, deliberately maintained wild cloud of tight curls; no styling beyond occasional finger-combing
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown, alert and constantly moving
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium brown with warm undertones reflecting mixed heritage
physical_description.complexion: Young face with high cheekbones, perpetually animated; gap-toothed grin is default expression; skin shows minor scrapes and calluses from tunnel work but generally healthy; no facial hair
distinguishing_marks: Geneware-modified ears: enlarged beyond baseline human proportion, with visible delicate ridge patterns beneath skin surface suggesting internal structural enhancement; ears capable of independent tilting and orientation; ear tissue slightly paler than surrounding skin where modification is most prominent
Callused palms and fingertips from repeated wall-contact during echo mapping
Small burn scar on left forearm (3cm) from contact with heated pipe during early tunnel work
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Enlarged, orientable geneware ears with visible internal ridge structure; ears move independently and frequently during conversation and work. Wears a battered handheld voice-recorder on a frayed fabric cord around neck as constant tool/accessory.
physical_description.posture_movement: Restless and kinetic; rarely still; frequently tilts head to angle ears toward sound sources; moves with a runner's efficiency through spaces; hands gesture expressively when talking; leans in close when listening intently; moves through environments with practiced familiarity suggesting deep spatial memory
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 5 practical wear: reinforced canvas utility pants with multiple pockets (some containing audio equipment); worn thermal underlayer; heavy canvas jacket with reflective patches; sturdy scuffed boots with good traction. Clothing shows regular wear and minor repairs but is well-maintained. Carries frequency analyzer and voice-recorder as constant accessories.
